ranking_policy: Agentic-AI verification scan for mini-ork, a task OS for autonomous coding agents whose verdict is EXECUTION-ANCHORED: a candidate change is judged by what the agent actually did in a real environment (tests, live observable surfaces, metamorphic invariants, oracle replay, execution traces), never by a model's opinion, and an LLM judge may only veto, never approve. Rank 2026 papers by how directly their VERIFICATION technique could be adopted by a surface that verifies AGENT BEHAVIOUR: long-horizon agent trajectory verification, tool-call and action validation, environment-state grounding, computer-use and GUI verification, sandboxed execution and isolation, multi-agent consensus and handoff verification, agent memory and context-state verification, plan and subgoal feasibility checking, in-flight runtime monitors and safety gates, observability/tracing-based verification, verifier validity auditing, reward-hacking and specification-gaming detection, judge reliability and calibration, calibrated abstention, held-out and contamination-free agent evaluation, and execution-anchored agent benchmarks. Papers that build or audit the accept/reject machinery for an agent run rank above papers that merely use an LLM judge as a side experiment; papers matched by multiple topics rank above single-topic matches; break ties by citation signal (citation_count, influential_citation_count) and recency.
